analysis:
Examined all supplied metadata, patches and source, including the new watchdog, changelog and test changes. The watchdog adds scheduled repository-wide CI cancellation/retry authority, distinct from the provider-process rollback watchdog in T-043. At .github/workflows/darkbloom-watchdog.yml:21-52 it runs only on schedule/manual dispatch, on a hosted runner, with actions/checks write permissions and no checkout or execution of branch source. Requests remain scoped to the context repository over HTTPS without redirect following (90-101); job names are sanitized before logging (145-149). Candidate selection requires an aged queued Darkbloom-labelled job with no runner (228-235), and the current attempt is rechecked before cancellation (260-274). No concrete token disclosure, code injection, or provider authorization/encryption/cache regression was established. A-001/A-003, TB-011/T-053/T-054 and T-041 behavior is not modified by these files.

scripts/test-darkbloom-route.py adds watchdog classification and static assertions for permissions, repository scoping and separation from credentialed workflows (head patch:590-617); it does not dynamically validate cancellation/retry behavior. The changelog's assertion of upstream copy identity is not independent proof.

Integration should verify the material retry contract: watchdog lines 155-176 re-run the router or whole workflow but do not themselves force fallback; lines 8-9 rely on plane unreachability or run_fallback_forced. Supplied route tests exercise fallback and run-attempt transmission, but do not establish that plane-side contract. Confirm it against the router/platform evidence before concluding rescue reliably avoids repeated paid execution or renewed stranding. Also reconcile mark-before-cancel recovery (191-212, 265-277) with manual/platform cancellation: a 409 leaves a resumable marker despite the comment saying not re-run. These are unresolved integration questions, not proven security regressions; unchanged callers and platform implementations were not supplied.
